craft.name: Voyager 1

mission.status: Operating in interstellar space (crossed the heliopause 2012)
mission.summary: Farthest human-made object; Grand Tour flybys of Jupiter (1979) and Saturn (1980).

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-31, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Voyager 2

mission.status: Operating in interstellar space (crossed the heliopause 2018)
mission.summary: Only spacecraft to visit Uranus (1986) and Neptune (1989).

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-32, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: New Horizons

mission.status: Extended mission in the Kuiper Belt
mission.summary: Pluto flyby July 2015, Arrokoth flyby January 2019.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-98, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Parker Solar Probe

mission.status: Operating; perihelia at about 9.86 solar radii
mission.summary: Repeated close passes through the solar corona using Venus gravity assists.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-96, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Juno

mission.status: Jupiter orbiter; check ephemeris end date (extended mission was planned through September 2025)
mission.summary: Polar orbits of Jupiter since July 2016: gravity, magnetosphere and atmosphere.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-61, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Europa Clipper

mission.status: Cruise to Jupiter (Earth gravity assist Dec 2026; arrival 2030 planned)
mission.summary: Will make repeated flybys of Europa to assess habitability.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-159, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Psyche

mission.status: Cruise to (16) Psyche (Mars gravity assist May 2025; arrival 2029 planned)
mission.summary: Will orbit the metal-rich asteroid (16) Psyche.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-255, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Lucy

mission.status: Cruise to the Jupiter Trojans (Donaldjohanson flyby Apr 2025; Trojan flybys from 2027)
mission.summary: First mission to multiple Jupiter Trojan asteroids.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-49, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: Hera

mission.status: Cruise to Didymos; arrival planned November 2026 (ESA, announced Oct 2025)
mission.summary: Will survey the DART impact outcome at Dimorphos and measure its mass.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-91, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: JUICE

mission.summary: Will study Ganymede, Europa and Callisto.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-28, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: BepiColombo

mission.status: Cruise to Mercury; orbit insertion planned November 2026
mission.summary: Two orbiters (MPO and Mio) to study Mercury.

craft.source: JPL Horizons API, COMMAND=-121, CENTER=500@10, EPHEM_TYPE=VECTORS, REF_SYSTEM=ICRF, REF_PLANE=FRAME

craft.name: James Webb Space Telescope

mission.status: Operating on a halo orbit around Sun-Earth L2
mission.summary: Infrared space observatory; track is geocentric.
